description: Election Commission - Declare that S. Mallikathevi  and V. Rajeswary as members of the Vadamarachchi South-West P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of members, nomination by political parties, and declaration of selected members by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the composition of an elected local government body through established electoral procedures.
